data.reading: the 2x2 curves are flat because the sector saturates from garbage (N a / dim >= 5, |B_all| = dim, the garbage-only baseline reaches E0): random bases of the B_sig size already reach E0, so CV4's margin is below E_tol.  That is why the 2x3 criteria are needed and why CV4 exists.  CV1-CV5 carry no verdict here; the recorded H0_2x2 verdicts are not touched
data.what_pass_means: CV0 only (structural): the 2x2 block was computed correctly from the unedited record; no device or convergence verdict
